verdict.rationale: Vercel documents first-party Sandbox SDKs (`@vercel/sandbox`) as a programmatic interface for creating sandboxes, running blocking or detached commands, streaming logs, managing files, retrieving sandboxes by name and extending timeouts. Access tokens are documented for use outside Vercel, and a public OpenAPI spec is reachable at vercel.com. missing for 10: confirmation that the OpenAPI/REST spec actually covers Sandbox endpoints, documented SDKs beyond JS/TS, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
